content.comment_body: Good afternoon. Is it possible to connect two [product_name] controllers to the same network? I have already added all available expansion modules, but my input and output requirements still exceed the capacity of a single unit. The only remaining solution seems to be adding another controller. Can both run on the same network?

Hello, In this forum, English is preferred—please use English for future posts, thank you. To answer your question: yes, it is possible. With two [product_name] devices running [version_no], you can set up a master/slave connection. Only the master device requires programming, while the slave simply provides its hardware resources to the master.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking to increase the number of inputs and outputs beyond what a single [product_name] device with expansion modules can handle. The main advice confirms that two [product_name] controllers using a master/slave configuration on the same network is possible, enabling one device to utilize the hardware of the other.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to link two [product_name] controllers on the same network to effectively expand their hardware resources, particularly inputs and outputs.
